company_name: F&K Delvotec Bondtechnik Singapore Pte Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: High — F&K Delvotec specializes in semiconductor assembly machines and bonding technology, which are critical for the semiconductor manufacturing process.
summary: F&K Delvotec Bondtechnik Singapore Pte Ltd provides high-quality semiconductor assembly machines and bonding solutions, catering to a global customer base. With extensive experience in various bonding processes, the company offers both stand-alone machines and fully integrated automatic production lines.

regional_presence.Singapore: F&K Delvotec has a subsidiary in Singapore, supporting its operations in Asia.
regional_presence.Germany: The company has manufacturing facilities in Germany, which is central to its production capabilities.
regional_presence.United States: F&K Delvotec operates a subsidiary in California, enhancing its presence in the North American market.
